records.issue_text: *Why it matters:* Every removal leaves `groups.user_count` one too high, permanently drifting until `Group.refresh_automatic_groups!` or a manual `reset_counters`. This is not cosmetic in this PR specifically, because the new UI is *built on* `user_count`: it drives the "Group members (N)" label, `totalPages`, and the `next`/`previous` clamps. Remove five members from a 10-person group and the pager still claims 10 users and offers pages full of nothing. The new spec (`spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb:129`) asserts `group.users.count` — a live COUNT query — so it passes while the cached column is wrong.
